SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of container offices for Kashipur. We build each unit to order at our own factory and dispatch it ready to use to the SIIDCUL Integrated Industrial Estate at Escort Farm, the Kashipur–Thakurdwara Road belt and mill sites across Kashipur. You deal with the maker, not a reseller. Browse our full Container Office Manufacturer for Kashipur Mills range for models, sizes and finishes.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. It reaches you fully finished — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — so a mill or plant can put a team inside the day it lands. No site masonry, no wet work, no long build wait.

Who buys a container office in Kashipur

Kashipur runs on paper, sugar, solvent, steel, lighting and agro-processing plants, plus the SIIDCUL vendors around them. Most enquiries reach us from:

  • Mills and process plants needing a plant-admin or QC cabin inside the premises
  • Factory gates needing a compact gate office or weighbridge cabin
  • SIIDCUL vendors setting up on an Escort Farm or Kundeshwari plot
  • Contractors on plant-expansion projects needing a temporary site office

These are administrative, gate and site cabins — clean, insulated work spaces on the premises, not process or storage structures.

Where we deliver in and around Kashipur

We supply container offices across the main industrial pockets of Kashipur:

  • SIIDCUL Integrated Industrial Estate, Escort Farm — 244713
  • Kashipur–Thakurdwara Road and Kundeshwari industrial belt — 244713
  • Kashipur city and nearby mill sites — 244713

Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or weighbridge cabinCompact, single door
20 ftStandard plant-admin or QC officeMost common for mill sites
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation. Need a cabin right at the plant entrance? Ask for a site office container for mill gate and yard use.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Kashipur uses the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with GI sheet
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price stays honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your plant works. Common additions for Kashipur sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, a weighbridge-facing window, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Greater Noida factory

Kashipur is served from our Greater Noida factory on North-zone dispatch. The road route runs through Hapur, Gajraula and Moradabad into Kashipur — roughly 220–250 km depending on your plot, so it is a genuine long haul rather than a short NCR run. Transit is typically within our standard 3–5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; long-haul cost and crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the region? See container offices we build for the Meerut industrial belt, our Lucknow container office units for UPSIDA sites, and the container office supply we handle around the Noida belt.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Kashipur

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size, panel type, insulation, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the long-haul delivery distance to Kashipur. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Kashipur?

There is no single fixed price. Cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the long-haul delivery distance to your Kashipur site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote.

Do you deliver to SIIDCUL Kashipur and the Kashipur–Thakurdwara Road belt?

Yes. We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory through Moradabad to the SIIDCUL Escort Farm estate, the Kundeshwari belt and mill sites across Kashipur — about 220–250 km. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Do you make gate offices and weighbridge cabins?

Yes. A 10 ft or 20 ft container cabin works well as a gate office or weighbridge office, and we can add a facing window, partition and electricals to suit. Sizes and layout are confirmed at quotation.

Are these cabins suitable for a paper or sugar mill site?

Yes, as admin, gate and supervisor offices on the mill premises. We supply clean, insulated steel office cabins — not process or storage structures. The exact spec is confirmed at quotation.

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your container office in Kashipur, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
